title: 16. Should và Ought to

intro.text: Bài 16 — Should và Ought to. Làm câu hỏi ngay sau mỗi phần, mở toggle để kiểm tra. Cuối bài có Mini Test 16 câu.
Trọng tâm TOEIC: Part 5 & 7 dùng should/ought to cho lời khuyên, kỳ vọng; mệnh đề giả định sau suggest/recommend/insist; và should have + V3 chỉ tiếc nuối.

parts.heading: Phần 1 · Lời khuyên và đề nghị
theory: should / ought to + V nguyên thể = nên làm gì (khuyên nhủ, đề nghị). ought to LUÔN có 'to'; should KHÔNG có 'to'.
keys: You should + V. You ought to + V. Phủ định: shouldn't + V (ought not to ít dùng).
traps: KHÔNG viết 'should to': sai 'should to update' → 'should update' hoặc 'ought to update'.
examples: You should submit the report before the deadline.
We ought to review the contract carefully.

questions.q:
You ___ submit the expense report before the monthly deadline.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. should to    D. shoulds
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||Lời khuyên → should + V nguyên thể.

questions.q:
All employees ___ wear safety helmets inside the factory.
A. should    B. should to    C. shoulds    D. shoulding
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||should + V nguyên thể.

questions.q:
We ___ review the contract terms before signing.
A. ought to    B. should to    C. ought    D. shoulds
questions.a: Đáp án: A (ought to). ||ought to + V nguyên thể (luôn có 'to').

questions.q:
You ___ ignore negative customer feedback.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. ought    D. should to
questions.a: Đáp án: B (shouldn't). ||Khuyên không nên → shouldn't + V.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"You should to update your password regularly."
questions.a: Lỗi: "should to update" → "should update". ||Sau should không có 'to'.

questions.q:
Managers ___ provide clear instructions to new team members.
A. should    B. should to    C. shoulds    D. shoulding
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||should + V.

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. We should to back up our files daily.
B. We ought to back up our files daily.
C. We ought back up our files daily.
D. We should backs up our files daily.
questions.a: Đáp án: B. ||ought to + V nguyên thể.

questions.q:
Điền vào hướng dẫn tuyển dụng (Part 6):
"Applicants ___ include a cover letter along with their resume."
A. should    B. should to    C. shoulds    D. shoulding
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||should + V.

parts.heading: Phần 2 · Kỳ vọng và dự đoán hợp lý
theory: should cũng diễn tả điều được kỳ vọng/dự kiến sẽ xảy ra một cách hợp lý.
keys: The package should arrive soon. = dự kiến, có cơ sở để tin.
traps: Vẫn là should + V nguyên thể: 'should be ready' (không 'should to be ready').

questions.q:
If there are no delays, the shipment ___ arrive by Friday.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. should to    D. shoulds
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||Dự kiến hợp lý → should arrive.

questions.q:
The new workflow ___ improve overall efficiency.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. should to    D. ought
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||Kỳ vọng → should improve.

questions.q:
With this much preparation, the event ___ go smoothly.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. should to    D. shoulds
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||Dự kiến → should go.

questions.q:
Traffic is light today, so we ___ get there on time.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. should to    D. ought
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||Dự đoán hợp lý → should get.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"The audit results should to be ready by tomorrow."
questions.a: Lỗi: "should to be" → "should be". ||Sau should không có 'to'.

questions.q:
The orientation session ___ take about two hours in total.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. should to    D. shoulds
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||Dự kiến thời lượng → should take.

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. He left early, so he should be home by now.
B. He left early, so he should to be home by now.
C. He left early, so he shoulds be home.
D. He left early, so he should being home.
questions.a: Đáp án: A. ||should + be (dự đoán hợp lý).

questions.q:
Điền vào hướng dẫn (Part 6):
"If you follow the guide, the installation ___ take only a few minutes."
A. should    B. should to    C. shoulds    D. shoulding
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||Dự kiến → should take.

parts.heading: Phần 3 · Mệnh đề giả định và had better
theory: Sau suggest, recommend, insist, request, advise, demand + that + S + (should) + V NGUYÊN THỂ. Cũng vậy với 'It is important/essential that S + V nguyên thể'. had better + V = lời khuyên mạnh.
keys: I suggest that he submit... (V nguyên thể). It is essential that the form be signed. You had better + V / had better not + V.
traps: Trong mệnh đề giả định, dùng V NGUYÊN THỂ cho mọi ngôi: 'that he submit' (không 'submits').

questions.q:
You ___ share confidential data with anyone outside the team.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. ought    D. should to
questions.a: Đáp án: B (shouldn't). ||Khuyên không nên → shouldn't.

questions.q:
The manager recommended that the report ___ revised before submission.
A. is    B. be    C. was    D. been
questions.a: Đáp án: B (be). ||recommend that S (should) be → dùng V nguyên thể 'be'.

questions.q:
It is important that every employee ___ the new safety policy.
A. follows    B. follow    C. following    D. followed
questions.a: Đáp án: B (follow). ||'It is important that S + V nguyên thể' (giả định).

questions.q:
We ___ better leave now to avoid the rush-hour traffic.
A. had    B. should    C. ought    D. would
questions.a: Đáp án: A (had). ||had better + V = lời khuyên mạnh.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"I suggest that he submits the application form early."
questions.a: Lỗi: "submits" → "submit". ||Mệnh đề giả định sau suggest dùng V nguyên thể.

questions.q:
You ___ better not miss the submission deadline this time.
A. had    B. should    C. ought    D. would
questions.a: Đáp án: A (had). ||had better not + V.

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. The board insisted that the CEO is present.
B. The board insisted that the CEO be present.
C. The board insisted that the CEO being present.
D. The board insisted that the CEO presents.
questions.a: Đáp án: B. ||insist that S + V nguyên thể (be).

questions.q:
Điền vào lời khuyên kiểm toán (Part 6):
"The auditor advised that the company ___ its records more frequently."
A. updates    B. update    C. updating    D. updated
questions.a: Đáp án: B (update). ||advise that S (should) update → V nguyên thể.

parts.heading: Phần 4 · should have + V3 và ought to
theory: should have + V3 = lẽ ra nên làm (nhưng đã KHÔNG làm). shouldn't have + V3 = lẽ ra không nên (nhưng đã làm). Diễn tả tiếc nuối/phê bình về quá khứ.
keys: You should have informed me. (nhưng bạn đã không). They shouldn't have ignored it. (nhưng họ đã ignore).
traps: Sau should have dùng V3: 'should have gone' (không 'should have went').

questions.q:
You ___ have informed me earlier about the schedule change.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. must    D. would
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||should have + V3 = lẽ ra nên (nhưng đã không).

questions.q:
We ___ have double-checked the figures before sending the report.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. could    D. would
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||should have checked = lẽ ra nên kiểm tra.

questions.q:
They ___ have ignored the early warning signs.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. ought    D. must
questions.a: Đáp án: B (shouldn't). ||shouldn't have + V3 = lẽ ra không nên (nhưng đã làm).

questions.q:
All staff ___ to attend the mandatory safety briefing.
A. should    B. ought    C. ought to    D. must to
questions.a: Đáp án: C (ought to). ||ought to + V nguyên thể.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"You should have went to the client meeting yesterday."
questions.a: Lỗi: "should have went" → "should have gone". ||Sau should have dùng V3 (gone).

questions.q:
The project failed; we ___ have planned the timeline more carefully.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. could    D. would
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||should have planned = lẽ ra nên lên kế hoạch kỹ hơn.

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. She should submitted it on time; now it's late.
B. She should have submitted it on time; now it's late.
C. She should have submit it on time.
D. She should has submitted it on time.
questions.a: Đáp án: B. ||should have + V3 (submitted).

questions.q:
Điền vào đánh giá (Part 6):
"The team ___ have tested the system thoroughly before the launch."
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. would    D. might
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||should have tested = lẽ ra nên kiểm thử (nhưng đã không).

parts.heading: Phần 5 · Luyện trộn nhanh (10 câu)
theory: Trộn lời khuyên, kỳ vọng, mệnh đề giả định và should have + V3.

questions.q:
You ___ review the terms and conditions before signing.
A. should    B. should to    C. shoulds    D. shoulding
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||Lời khuyên → should + V.

questions.q:
If there are no issues, the delivery ___ arrive within three days.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. should to    D. ought
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||Dự kiến hợp lý → should arrive.

questions.q:
We ___ have backed up the data; now some of it is lost.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. could    D. would
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||should have backed up = lẽ ra nên (nhưng đã không).

questions.q:
Visitors ___ enter restricted areas without authorization.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. ought    D. should to
questions.a: Đáp án: B (shouldn't). ||Khuyên/cấm nhẹ → shouldn't.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"Managers ought review performance every quarter."
questions.a: Lỗi: "ought review" → "ought to review". ||ought to luôn có 'to'.

questions.q:
It is essential that the document ___ signed by both parties.
A. is    B. be    C. was    D. been
questions.a: Đáp án: B (be). ||'It is essential that S + V nguyên thể' → be.

questions.q:
With additional staff, the heavy workload ___ become more manageable.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. should to    D. shoulds
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||Dự kiến → should become.

questions.q:
You ___ better confirm the venue booking today.
A. had    B. should    C. ought    D. would
questions.a: Đáp án: A (had). ||had better + V = khuyên mạnh.

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. He should have called to cancel; he just didn't show up.
B. He should called to cancel.
C. He should have call to cancel.
D. He should has called to cancel.
questions.a: Đáp án: A. ||should have + V3 (called).

questions.q:
Điền vào nội quy (Part 6):
"Employees ___ submit their timesheets by Friday each week."
A. should    B. should to    C. shoulds    D. shoulding
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||Quy định/lời khuyên → should + V.

minitest.heading: 🏋️ Bài luyện tập tổng hợp (Mini Test · 16 câu)
minitest.note: Làm liên tục 16 câu, gợi ý 8–10 phút, KHÔNG mở đáp án giữa chừng. Mục tiêu: đúng từ 13/16 trở lên.

questions.q:
You ___ proofread the document before printing it.
A. should    B. should to    C. shoulds    D. shoulding
questions.a: A (should). ||Lời khuyên → should + V.

questions.q:
We ___ review the budget before the board meeting.
A. ought to    B. should to    C. ought    D. shoulds
questions.a: A (ought to). ||ought to + V nguyên thể.

questions.q:
If the weather stays clear, the flight ___ depart on time.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. should to    D. ought
questions.a: A (should). ||Dự kiến hợp lý → should depart.

questions.q:
You ___ have informed the client about the delay sooner.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. must    D. would
questions.a: A (should). ||should have informed = lẽ ra nên.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"You should to register before the event starts."
questions.a: Lỗi: "should to register" → "should register". ||Sau should không có 'to'.

questions.q:
The manager recommended that the policy ___ updated immediately.
A. is    B. be    C. was    D. been
questions.a: B (be). ||recommend that S (should) be → V nguyên thể.

questions.q:
Staff ___ not leave the building during a fire drill.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. ought    D. should to
questions.a: B (shouldn't). ||Khuyên không nên → shouldn't.

questions.q:
They ___ have rushed the launch; that's why bugs appeared.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. would    D. might
questions.a: B (shouldn't). ||shouldn't have rushed = lẽ ra không nên (nhưng đã làm).

questions.q:
It is important that each applicant ___ two references.
A. provides    B. provide    C. providing    D. provided
questions.a: B (provide). ||'It is important that S + V nguyên thể'.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"We should have went over the contract more carefully."
questions.a: Lỗi: "should have went" → "should have gone". ||Sau should have dùng V3.

questions.q:
With proper maintenance, the machine ___ last for many years.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. should to    D. shoulds
questions.a: A (should). ||Dự kiến → should last.

questions.q:
You ___ better submit the form before noon.
A. had    B. should    C. ought    D. would
questions.a: A (had). ||had better + V = khuyên mạnh.

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. The auditor insisted that the records is updated.
B. The auditor insisted that the records be updated.
C. The auditor insisted that the records being updated.
D. The auditor insisted that the records updates.
questions.a: B. ||insist that S + V nguyên thể (be updated).

questions.q:
The order ___ arrive by Wednesday under normal conditions.
A. should    B. should to    C. shoulds    D. shoulding
questions.a: A (should). ||Dự kiến → should arrive.

questions.q:
We ___ have backed up the files; we lost a day's work.
A. should    B. shouldn't    C. could    D. would
questions.a: A (should). ||should have backed up = lẽ ra nên.

questions.q:
Điền vào hướng dẫn (Part 6):
"Customers ___ keep their receipt in case a refund is needed."
A. should    B. should to    C. shoulds    D. shoulding
questions.a: A (should). ||Lời khuyên → should + V.

summary: should / ought to + V nguyên thể = lời khuyên, đề nghị, kỳ vọng. ought to luôn có 'to'; should không có 'to'.
should cũng diễn tả dự kiến hợp lý: The package should arrive soon.
Mệnh đề giả định sau suggest/recommend/insist/advise/request + that + S + (should) + V NGUYÊN THỂ. 'It is important/essential that S + V nguyên thể'. had better + V = khuyên mạnh.
should have + V3 = lẽ ra nên (nhưng đã không); shouldn't have + V3 = lẽ ra không nên (nhưng đã làm).

summary_callouts.text: Bẫy: 'should to' (sai) → 'should' hoặc 'ought to'. 'should have went' (sai) → 'should have gone' (V3). Sau suggest/recommend that... dùng V nguyên thể cho mọi ngôi.
Sau khi làm xong: nếu đúng dưới 13/16, đổi Trạng thái bài thành "Cần ôn" và làm lại Phần 3–4 sau 1 ngày.
